name: The trail stops here

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Classic quest chain; exact in-world date unknown

summary: Jaina rewards the investigator; Varian’s disappearance remains unresolved.
description: Jaina thanks the adventurer with her signet ring. That gift marks the service rendered, not the return of the missing king. The original chain closes at Theramore with Hendel held for questioning and Varian still absent from the story’s known scenes. The evidence has moved across Stormwind, Duskwood, the Wetlands and the marsh coast; the destination of the royal ship and the full design behind its disappearance remain beyond this account.
